description: An assistant principal must finalize the school's graduation ceremony plan, including the number of sessions, guest access, diploma release, interpretation, and student safety arrangements, with input from the registrar, facilities coordinator, family liaison, and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: The school's graduation ceremony is scheduled for June 12 in the civic auditorium.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Bennett has final authority over the ceremony plan and its implementation instructions.
shared_context.S3: The current draft proposes one ceremony, three guest tickets per graduate, diploma release for all graduating seniors, English-only announcements, and general seating by homeroom.
shared_context.S4: The auditorium provides a stage, a public entrance, a graduate entrance, and two backstage holding areas.
shared_context.S5: As part of the school's normal event-planning routine, Ms. Bennett asks the registrar, facilities coordinator, family liaison, and counselor to report any information that must be reflected before she approves the plan.

PF1.text: The registrar's completed credit audit shows exactly seven seniors are short of graduation requirements and cannot receive diplomas at the ceremony; Mr. Shah finished the audit this morning, but the results have not yet been entered in the ceremony roster.

PF2.text: The civic auditorium's fire marshal approval limits each ceremony session to 450 people, while the school has 286 graduates and the draft's three-ticket plan would produce 858 attendees; Ms. Rivera confirmed the limit with the venue yesterday, but the venue specification has not been added to the event worksheet.

PF3.text: Family confirmations show that interpretation is required in both Spanish and Somali for graduation announcements and instructions; Ms. Okafor completed the confirmations this week, but the language requests have not been added to the ceremony plan.

PF4.text: A current court order prohibits contact between two graduating students, so they must be assigned to separate ceremony sessions and use separate arrival and departure entrances; Dr. Lawson verified the order in the student-services file, but it has not been attached to the ceremony seating plan.

acceptance_conditions: The ceremony must use two sessions.
Each graduate must receive no more than two guest tickets.
Diplomas must be withheld from exactly seven seniors who are short of graduation requirements.
Spanish and Somali interpretation must be provided.
The two students covered by the court order must be placed in separate sessions with separate arrival and departure entrances.
The roster audit, capacity plan, language-access plan, and student-safety plan must each be reflected in the settlement.

content_checks.C5: 'separate session' in decisions['student_safety_arrangement'] and 'separate arrival' in decisions['student_safety_arrangement'] and 'separate departure' in decisions['student_safety_arrangement']
content_checks.C6: any('roster' in c['type'] or 'diploma' in c['type'] or '7' in c['detail'] or 'seven' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('capacity' in c['type'] or 'venue' in c['type']) and 'PF2' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('interpret' in c['type'] or ('Spanish' in c['detail'] and 'Somali' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('safety' in c['type'] or 'court' in c['type'] or ('separate session' in c['detail'] and 'separate arrival' in c['detail'] and 'separate departure' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The credit audit changes diploma release from all seniors to withholding diplomas from exactly seven incomplete seniors and requires the roster to reflect that number.
The 450-person session limit and 858-person three-ticket total change the plan to multiple sessions with no more than two guest tickets per graduate and require capacity information to be reflected.
The family confirmations change language access from English-only to English, Spanish, and Somali and require interpretation information to be reflected in the plan.
The court order changes the student arrangement to separate sessions and separate arrival and departure entrances and requires the counselor's safety fact to be cited in the decision.
